requirement.statement: The .NET OM SHALL provide a code/document knowledge graph capsule that indexes code/doc facts into Cozo and exposes agent-oriented query facades.

case.given: A batch containing repository, file, symbol, relation, and doc block facts
case.then: The system SHALL persist facts into CodeKnowledge relations without requiring HTTP, MCP, or server concerns

case.given: Indexed symbols, calls, and documentation links
case.when: The caller asks for symbol context, impact of change, docs for code, relation explanation, or wiki plan
case.then: The system SHALL return structured C# domain results built on Om.Query and Cozo Datalog queries
